title: The <SUP>12</SUP>CO gas structures of protoplanetary disks in the Upper Scorpius region
question: Infer bulk gas-disk properties (radius, 12CO emission-layer height, brightness temperature, integrated flux) for the Upper Scorpius disks by fitting 12CO J=3-2 visibilities with parametric models

recipe.method: Take the 12CO J=3-2 detections with S/N>=3 from the earlier ALMA survey of Upper Sco (83 sources) and attempt to fit all

recipe.goal: Fit 12CO visibilities with parametric disk models (A: two-layer, B: midplane) using csalt and emcee
recipe.method: Model visibility spectra in LSRK at each timestamp, convolve with the ALMA correlator SRF, likelihood with spectral covariance, sample posterior with emcee; prescription A for 33 resolved disks, B for 4 marginally resolved disks; cloud-absorbed frequency ranges excluded from the likelihood
key_parameters: 250 burn-in steps; 90 walkers; 1000 steps before first convergence check
Stop when relative change in the median of each parameter is below 5% over the last 500 steps; otherwise continue
Priors chosen per disk for inc, PA, v_sys, M*, r_tau and r_z from the channel maps; Gaussian and uniform priors (example in Table 3)
Best fit = median, uncertainties = 68% interval of posterior
assumptions: Emission from two thin layers, back surface mirrored from front (z_b = -z_f)
Pure Keplerian rotation and purely thermal line width
Temperature and optical depth profiles equal for front and back surfaces
Model B: emission in the midplane with constant optical depth out to R_out

recipe.goal: Image data, best-fit model and residual visibilities for channel-map comparison
recipe.method: tclean on data, best-fit model visibilities and residual visibilities with identical parameters
key_parameters: image size 1500 pix, cell 0.01 arcsec, scales (0, 10, 30, 60), robust=1, threshold 20 mJy per beam, Keplerian mask

recipe.goal: Derive gas-disk radii R68 and R90
recipe.method: Compute the peak surface-brightness profile of the front surface at the 12CO J=3-2 rest frequency from the best-fit model, integrate in cylindrical coordinates, take radii enclosing 68% and 90% of the emission; uncertainties from MCMC draws (16th and 84th percentiles)

recipe.goal: Measure data and model integrated 12CO fluxes
recipe.method: Moment-0 maps over +/-15 km/s around systemic velocity, summed inside a geometric mask from the best-fit geometry with size R90+0.2 arcsec; uncertainty from the scatter of the mask moved to 8 emission-free positions; model fluxes from best-fit cubes with bootstrapped uncertainty
Linear regression of log R90 against log L_CO (flux scaled to 140 pc) with linmix; compared with Long2022 slope and intercept

recipe.goal: Derive emission-surface heights and aspect ratio <z/r>
recipe.method: Evaluate z(r) from random MCMC draws (median, 16th and 84th percentiles); r_cut is where the height profile stops increasing, r_taper = 0.8 r_cut, <z/r> averaged over 0<=r<=r_taper; compare with literature via Kaplan-Meier estimator and log-rank test

recipe.goal: Relate 12CO brightness temperature at 10 au to stellar luminosity and dust temperature
recipe.method: Fit T_b,10 against L*; compare with blackbody equilibrium temperature and the superheated-dust temperature from Dullemond2001 Eq. 7 using Planck mean opacities of pure silicate; infer opacity-temperature exponent beta
Linear fit of <z/r> on R90 after removing the face-on disk J16042165-2130284 and treating three disks as upper limits; compared with Galloway-Sprietsma+25 best fit

score_reason: Data come from public ALMA archive projects and the priors, scripts and csalt are on GitHub, with numeric tables, but csalt is in prep. and key inputs (visibility selection, stellar luminosities, per-disk setup) are external or unstated.
